about: Georeference of the RPC City Council Wards poster: projected metres -> page space of the poster PDF. Fitted by tools/georef_fit.py from control_points; check_points are held out of the fit. Used by tools/extract_ward_poster.py to move the ward shapes into districts.json's page space.
source_title: City Council Wards (36x36 poster), Clarksville-Montgomery County Regional Planning Commission, updated February 25, 2026
page_space: PDF user space of the poster page (2592 x 2592 pt), y down

projection.name: NAD83 / Tennessee State Plane (EPSG:32136), metres
projection.datum_note: Inputs are NAD83 degrees; WGS84 (what a geocoder returns) differs by about 1 m here, far below the margin.

projection_finding: The poster is drawn in Tennessee State Plane, north up: the fitted affine has no measurable rotation (-0.002 deg) and equal x/y scale (ratio 1.00005), at 9.83 m per point. Its road lines are the TIGER road lines: 32,002 points sampled every 6 pt along the drawn roads lie a median 0.38 m (p90 2.2 m) from the nearest TIGER road line after the fit; the p99 of 40 m is roads drawn on the poster that TIGER lacks or routes differently.
method: Control and check points are crossings of two named roads inside the city where each road runs straight through (4 legs, each over 80 m, crossing angle over 60 deg). lonlat is the TIGER node (NAD83); page_xy is the crossing of the two drawn centre lines (0.8 or 2.0 pt black strokes) whose directions match the TIGER legs within 8 deg, near the spot predicted by a first alignment of the whole drawn road network to TIGER. Points were picked to cover every side of the city; dual carriageways (I-24) were left out. Working scripts were one-off; tools/georef_fit.py refits from the points stored here and tools/extract_ward_poster.py moves the ward shapes into districts.json's page space.

tiger-roads-tnm.title: USGS The National Map Transportation for Tennessee (Trans_RoadSegment), whose road lines in Montgomery County come from Census TIGER/Line (2016 BAS All Roads; some segments from the 2018 MAF/TIGER extract)

tiger-place-2025.title: 2025 TIGER/Line Shapefile, Place (U.S. Census Bureau), Clarksville city, TN, as redistributed in USGS The National Map Governmental Unit Boundaries for Tennessee (GU_IncorporatedPlace, load date 2025-09-29)
tiger-place-2025.licence: Public domain (U.S. federal government work; USGS metadata: no use constraints)

sources.access_note: Read from the USGS redistribution of TIGER, as for georef.json (the Census hosts are not reachable from the build sandbox). Nothing from APSU or mcgtn GIS services was used.

boundary_margin_basis.transform_note: largest leave-one-out control error (2.3 m); held-out check points max 1.8 m
boundary_margin_basis.traced_shapes_note: districts.json ward paths are simplified (0.12 pt) and rounded to 0.1 pt in the county map's page space; tools/extract_ward_poster.py measures the max Hausdorff distance to the unsimplified trace (wards.max_simplify_error_m, 4.8 m)
boundary_margin_basis.source_drawing_note: judgment call, not measured: the poster's vectors are an ArcGIS Pro export, which can drop vertices closer than its output resolution (about 0.24 pt = 2.4 m at 300 dpi)
boundary_margin_basis.geocoder_note: the same allowance as georef.json: the Census geocoder interpolates along street address ranges on the street centre line, and many ward lines follow street centre lines. Judgment call, not measured.
boundary_margin_basis.district_map_note: the ward paths are stored in the district map's page space through georef.json, so a looked-up point and the ward lines pass through the same district affine: its error cancels and adds nothing here
boundary_margin_basis.outline_check: TIGER 2025 Clarksville place outline (tiger-place-2025) sampled every 50 m against the poster's city outline (union of the wards) after the fit: median 0.3 m, p90 0.7 m, 93.5% within 10 m, 96.5% within 76 m. The rest are annexations: 0.36 km2 is in the wards but not in the 2025 TIGER place (annexed since), 0.06 km2 the other way, of 261.5 km2.
